data_objects.name: hotel_properties
data_objects.meaning: Hotel or lodging-property listings with location, rating, review, type, and brand attributes.
data_objects.notes: Brand hierarchy and rating fields are attached to property-level records.

variables.name: hotel_id
variables.meaning: Identifier for the hotel or lodging property.

variables.name: star_rating
variables.meaning: Star-classification rating assigned to the property.

variables.name: bubble_score
variables.meaning: Numeric bubble-style review score associated with the property.

variables.name: review_count
variables.meaning: Number of reviews associated with the property record.

variables.name: brand_name
variables.meaning: Immediate hotel brand name, when available.

variables.name: parent_brand_name
variables.meaning: Parent organization or umbrella brand associated with brand_name, when available.

structure.description: Each row represents one lodging property, with hotel_id serving as the property identifier.
city_name and hotel_type group properties by location and type; brand_name and parent_brand_name encode a two-level brand hierarchy.
Empty CSV fields encode unavailable ratings or brand information.

uncertainties: The geographic definition of city association and the source or snapshot date of review_count are not stated.
The bubble_score scale and its relationship to star_rating are not documented.
Blank brand fields do not distinguish independent properties from unknown brand affiliation.
annotation_notes: The annotation is grounded only in the declared train.csv table.
